text:
The plate is a square plate of roughly 24 cm, and it spans about 430 px in the image, so about 18 px per cm.

There are two corn pieces. One is a cob segment lying on its side, about 120 px long (about 6 cm) and 90 px across (about 4.5 cm). The other is a cob segment standing on end, about 95 px across (about 5 cm) and roughly 2.5 cm thick.

Each segment is a short cob piece of about 3 cm length. The first one is a bit longer, around 4 cm. A full cob of about 18 cm weighs roughly 250 g including the core, and the edible kernels are about 90 g. That gives about 14 g per cm of cob, so the two segments (about 3 cm and 4 cm, 7 cm total) come to roughly 100 g, or perhaps 80 g with the cob core.

Boiled corn is about 95 kcal per 100 g for kernels. Counting the cob as part of the weight, the energy is about 80 kcal.
